<!-- pr-reviewer: ac55226aeda1613b7697b625c46e344c7ff4ecad -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge** - the branch now conflicts with `main` in code, and the conflict is semantic in `posting.rs`.

**What looks good**
- Own / follow-the-document law mirrors #343; `SetSetupPostOptions` is an undoable command that refuses a no-op by name; project key is additive (no version bump) and omitted when `None`, so old files save byte-identically.
- Unknown threading word is a named corrupt-file refusal; setups disagreeing on program-wide output are refused by name.
- New modules carry provenance lines; no new dependencies, `build.rs`, `.github` or scripts; no non-test `unwrap/expect/panic`; no `CHANGELOG.md` edit; decision file in `docs/decisions/`; body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #389`.

**Local results (PR head, built as-is; trial merge not possible, see below)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| app `setup_post_options` | 8 passed |
| app `project_roundtrip` | 69 passed |
| ui lib `setup_post_options` | 3 passed |
| clippy app + ui `--all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

These are on the PR head, not merged with current `upstream/main`.

**Requested before merge**
1. Merge `upstream/main` into the branch; it conflicts in `crates/app/src/posting.rs`, `crates/ui/src/state.rs`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mod.rs` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs`. The UI ones are module lists (keep both sides: `setup_post_page` + `fixture_rows`; `setup_post_options` + `program_entry`; `state_setup_post_options` + `fixture_view`/`program_entry`/`EntryVerb`).
2. `posting.rs` (around the `skip_stops` / `after:` lines, ~782-800): main (#155) now computes `afters = program_entry::posted_afters(world, &ops, skip_stops)` with a single document-wide `skip_stops` and uses `afters.get(name)` for `after`. The PR reads skip per op from its setup via `setup_post_options::of(world, op.setup)`. Combine them so `posted_afters` takes the per-setup switch (Pause/Home entries must honour each op's setup, not only the document), and re-run `setup_post_options`, the #155 program-entry suites and the posting goldens after the merge. Silent wrong stops in posted NC is the case to avoid here.
3. After the merge, re-gate (app + ui suites touched, clippy) and push; I did not run the #155 tests against the combined code.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs` is 3875 lines and `posting.rs` 1113, both far over ~400; the PR adds to them. Flagging growth only.
- Snapshot/GPU headless reds the PR lists on main are platform/known.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 78f0e8cf3567385d4d4336193ba18b72219e170c -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Thanks for the rework. The per-op skip is the part I checked hardest.

## What looks good
- `program_entry::posted_afters` (crates/app/src/program_entry.rs:126-182): a Pause/Home entry is skipped exactly when the op whose gap it folds into (the last posted op before it) skips stops in its own setup. That op's own after-action is also muted, and the entry `continue`s before `merge`, so it can neither post nor raise a "second after-action" refusal. An entry in a non-skipping op's gap is kept, merged and still refused on a clash. Nothing is silently dropped or wrongly kept.
- With every op skipping, the result matches the old document-wide early return: all muted and no entry can refuse, including an entry ahead of the first op.
- An entry ahead of every posted op follows the first posted op's switch. That choice is documented; it is muted if that setup skips, otherwise refused by name as before.
- `an_entry_in_a_skipping_setups_gap_is_muted_with_its_op` pins the mixed case, with undo bringing the clash back.
- The skip predicate in `posting.rs:709` reads `setup_post_options::of(op.setup)`, the same resolution as `own()` (an op with no setup falls to the first setup). Output and thread options are program-wide, and disagreeing setups are refused by name (`program_problems`, wired into `verification_report`).
- The undoable command, the additive project key (still v57, byte-identical when unset) and the new modules (provenance lines, no unwrap/expect) all follow the laws. The change touches no build.rs, `.github/`, scripts or dependencies.

## Local results (merged with upstream/main; already up to date, no conflicts)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| app `setup_post_options` | 9 passed |
| app `program_entry` | 9 passed |
| app `after_op` | 10 passed |
| app `project_roundtrip` | 69 passed |
| app `setup_mount` | 6 passed |
| ui `--lib` (CWD `crates/ui`) | 378 passed, 2 failed, 5 ignored |
| `clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

The two ui failures are `headless_run_succeeds` (the known GPU headless red that your PR body also lists) and `structural::shell_structure_light`. The second passes on two reruns on its own, so it looks like a load flake and not this PR.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Notes (not blocking)
- The PR body says "draft until the GUI check". It is now open (not a draft), so the maintainer should decide whether the hands-on GUI check has happened.
- Not exercised: the real rfd save dialog, and a per-setup G76 post end to end.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: e04a875d30f2d54cb63e2a8653b37e819a27c5ae -->
**Delta review** of the merge-of-main since my last review at `78f0e8c`. Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

**What changed since `78f0e8c`:** only the author's merge commit `e04a875` ("Merge main into issue/389-setup-tool-list-v2") on top of main's own merges. No new own code.

**Checked**
- Resolution keeps both sides: `project/wire.rs` collects the document options through the setup-aware `setup_post_options::document()` and keeps main's `end_units` condition; `setup_options_dto.rs` carries #596's `end_units` through a setup's own options (`None` = Leave, so older files read the same; an unknown value is refused by the setup's name); `egui_app/tests.rs` lists both mods.
- `gh pr diff --name-only` lists only the PR's own files (posting.rs, schema.rs, project, setup_post_options, tool_list_export, ui setup pages). No `.cps`, golden, snapshot PNG, CHANGELOG or RECOMMENDED edits, so main's post rules are untouched: per-machine tool clash, per-mount NC files, probe hooks, Tormach safe_retract, comment escaping, end-in-native-units.
- The head already contains current main (`4827fde`), so the trial merge was a no-op.

**Results (head, own worktree and target)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test setup_post_options --test tormach_end_units --test posting --test golden_cl --test tool_list --test setup_mounts_post`: all pass (golden_cl 23).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post`: all pass.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- setup_post` (from `crates/ui`): 3 passed.
- `cargo clippy -D warnings` on app and ui libs plus the two touched suites: clean.

**Note for the maintainer (not this PR):** `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets` fails on current main in `crates/app/tests/lathe_thread_travel.rs:83` (`E0063: missing field 'hand'`); that file is identical to main's.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
